data.one_liner: High-performance responsive scaling package for Flutter with drop-in widgets and caching.
data.what_it_does: Provides responsive scaling for layouts, typography, and geometry based on a base design size. Includes precomputed multipliers, LRU caching for scalar lookups, and drop-in widget replacements to automatically handle sizing across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
use_when: You want an optimized alternative to flutter_screenutil for responsive design
You need drop-in widgets that automatically scale raw design numbers
You require caching to make scaling performance faster than standard map lookups
avoid_when: You prefer pure constraint-based adaptive layouts without artboard scaling
You do not use a fixed design resolution artboard
strengths: ~3x faster scalar lookups using precomputed multipliers
Drop-in widget replacements like SKContainer and SKText
Low rebuild sensitivity to prevent excessive rendering during keyboard open/close
weaknesses: Requires migration or usage of specific SK widgets or extensions to benefit
Artboard-based scaling may not suit every fluid design workflow
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and initialize ScaleKitBuilder at the root of the app.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you want automatic responsive resizing and scaling based on breakpoints rather than explicit screenutil-style multipliers.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you prefer building layouts explicitly per device screen type using SizingInformation.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it for a simpler percentage-based sizing approach without caching engines or drop-in widget suites.

data.minimal_example:
SKContainer(
  width: 200,
  height: 100,
  padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
  child: SKText('Hello', fontSize: 16),
)
